mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 7.5% in a 3-month window, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce corporate earnings expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 7.5% (3-month average), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicate a broad-based economic slowdown that triggers risk-off sentiment, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The negative return signal fails when both HOUST and PAYEMS decline simultaneously in more than 60% of cases with SPX 20-day returns positive (Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%), a stable federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS within 0.1% of prior month) signals insufficient monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS is stable (within 0.1% of prior month), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates robust economic activity that supports corporate profits, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO growth fails to predict positive returns when INDPRO rises in more than 60% of cases with SPX 5-day returns negative (Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales (RSAFS) falls below its 3-month moving average by more than 0.5%, it signals weakening consumer demand that reduces corporate revenue expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS falls below the threshold, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 7.0%), a decline in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals worsening labor market conditions that trigger negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 7.0% and PAYEMS declines, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in real GDP (GDPC1) indicates expanding economic activity that supports equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 growth fails to predict positive returns when GDPC1 rises in more than 60% of cases with SPX 60-day returns negative (Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window).
